name: biome_color_blend
describe: 3x3 biome color blend: sums the packed 0xRRGGBB grass colors of the 9 blocks in the box (pos-1 .. pos+1), integer-divides each channel by 9, repacks. Golden captured live from real Minecraft via NetheriteMod 'capture_biome' using the GRASS_COLOR resolver (getGrassColorAtPos). Integer arithmetic, bitwise compare.
